EdwCustomTableConfig.CreateViewQuery:
CREATE VIEW [Finance].[vw_GRP__JobRevRecognitionDates] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS SELECT JobHeaderKey AS JH, DateList = LEFT(STRING_AGG(CAST(TypeDatePairDistinct.RecognitionDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY TypeDatePairDistinct.RecognitionDate), 4000) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT JobHeaderKey, TypeDatePair.RecognitionDate FROM Finance.BAS__RevenueRecognition CROSS APPLY dbo.GetRevRecognitionTypeDatePair(RecognitionType, RecognitionDate) AS TypeDatePair ) TypeDatePairDistinct GROUP BY JobHeaderKey
